retention.reportPersonalContent: Minimized within 90 days of receipt; not a promise to erase every record.
retention.photos: Access closes 24 hours before the 90-day report deadline; deletion workflow must be verified by Lane 3. Provider internal timing requires owner approval.
retention.deviceFollowUp: Report ID, consent version, deadline and confirmed photo count only; at most 89 days. Photo bytes are not persisted by app.
retention.appAttest: Key registration/revocation retention is separate; no blanket 90-day deletion promise.
retention.supportAndProvider: Not established by report retention. Owner must confirm.
